description.zh: 百炼APIKEY
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API key.

Specifies whether to use the model's BATCH API. This reduces the cost by half and processes the task within 24 hours.

(The BATCH API is supported by stable and some latest versions of Qwen-Max, Qwen-Plus, Qwen-Flash, Qwen-Turbo, and Qwen-Long. It is also supported by QwQ series models, such as qwq-plus and qwq-32b-preview, and some third-party models, such as deepseek-r1 and deepseek-v3.)

description.zh: 待挖掘的素材内容列表（url、fileKey、contents 三选一）（此数组不超过200个，更多请走fileKey或contents文件形式）
description.en: The list of content to analyze. Specify one of \`url\`, \`fileKey\`, or \`contents\`. The array can contain a maximum of 200 items. To process more items, use the \`fileKey\` parameter or upload a file.

description.zh: 素材ID
description.en: The content ID.

description.zh: 素材内容（字符数不能超过1w个）
description.en: The content. The number of characters cannot exceed 10,000.

description.zh: 业务补充信息
description.en: Additional business information.

description.zh: 待挖掘的素材内容文件FileKey(url、fileKey、contents 三选一)（fileKey 是从全妙SASS页面上传所获取到的唯一key）
description.en: The file key of the content file to analyze. Specify one of \`url\`, \`fileKey\`, or \`contents\`. The file key is a unique key that you obtain after you upload a file on the Quanmiao Software as a Service (SaaS) page.

description.zh: 过滤标签
description.en: The filter tags.

description.zh: 给到大模型的 筛选的标签定义Prompt
description.en: The prompt that defines the filter tag for the LLM.

description.zh: 过滤标签名称
description.en: The filter tag name.

description.zh: 模型ID
description.en: The model ID.

description.zh: 输出格式描述提示词(不传的话默认会根据任务描述生成json格式)
description.en: The prompt that describes the output format. If this parameter is not specified, the output is generated in JSON format based on the task description.

description.zh: 是否正向筛选（true-正向筛选，默认；false-反向筛选）
description.en: Specifies whether to perform positive filtering. \`true\`: positive filtering (default). \`false\`: negative filtering.

description.zh: 是否启用溯源（启用溯源时不支持自定义outputformat）
description.en: Specifies whether to enable traceability. If you enable traceability, you cannot customize the output format.

description.zh: 内容标签
description.en: The content tags.

description.zh: 给到大模型的标签定义Prompt
description.en: The prompt that defines the tag for the Large Language Model (LLM).

description.zh: 标签名称
description.en: The tag name.

description.zh: 任务描述
description.en: The task description.

description.zh: 待挖掘的素材内容文件URL(url、fileKey、contents 三选一)（整体文件大小不能超过100M，素材个数不能超过6w条）
description.en: The URL of the content file to analyze. Specify one of \`url\`, \`fileKey\`, or \`contents\`. The file size cannot exceed 100 MB. The number of content items cannot exceed 60,000.
The [workspace ID](~~2782167~~).

title.zh: 提交企业VOC挖掘异步任务
title.en: Submit an enterprise VOC mining asynchronous task
